description: Strategic Cycle Network DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Cycle Network This dataset contains a spatial map of the network of existing strategic cycle routes in Dublin City. Strategic Routes are shown in red and labelled: Contarf, Malahide, Swords, Ballymun, Finglas, Blanchardstown, Lucan, Clonalkin, Rathfarnham, Tallaght, Ranelagh, Stillorgan. Coverage: Dublin City. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Cycle Lanes, Transport and Infrastructure, bicycle lanes, cycle, cycle infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in DWG. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
